item.title: Columbia GSAPP: On the Edge of Legibility symposium
item.description: Background In April 2026, the Columbia Graduate School of Architecture, Planning and Preservation (GSAPP) hosted a symposium titled On the Edge of Legibility: Architecture and Its Peripheries. Panelists from around the world presented research across a diverse range of subjects that responded to Croatian art historian Ljubo Karaman’s theory of the Freedom of the Periphery and French poet Edouard Glissant’s call for the right to opacity. No specific architectural movement, country, time period, or material encapsulated the whole theme.
